title: Measuring Social Biases in Masked Language Models by Proxy of Prediction Quality

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs from the Crowdsourced Stereotype Pairs Benchmark (CPS) and StereoSet (SS) datasets using an Iterative Masking Experiment (IME) with attention-weighted proxy functions.
